item.title: About
item.description: Hello! I’m a third year PhD student in Computer Graphics at the University of Toronto, supervised by Prof. Eitan Grinspun. I work in all sorts of physical simulations, from rigid body mechanics to fluid dynamics. I am particularly interested in methods for interacting with and controlling such simulations, with the goal of helping users build, design and create within the bounds of physical constraints for applications in animation, robotics and engineering.
